'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Greg Shaw DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
